As a seasoned experienced professional with a comprehensive understanding of UC, campus, and unit academic practices, policies, and procedures, resolves moderate to complex academic HR-related issues affecting a broad range of academic titles in imaginative and practical ways.
Under general direction, incumbent manages all academic functions in the Department of Family Medicine and

. This includes equal opportunity/affirmative action issues, academic recruitment, appointments, merit increases, promotions, sabbaticals, grievances, layoffs and union issues, employee relations, compensation, training and development, Advisor to the Chairs, Chief Administrative Officers (Department Administrators), and faculty with regard to Academic Personnel concerns. Responsible for academic appointments and yearly renewals of all full-time and part-time faculty.
Exepected Salary Range: $79,200.00 - $100,000.00/ annually
Extensive knowledge of UC Academic Personnel policies and procedures.
Working knowledge of UC Human Resources and labor relations policies and procedures.
High level writing skills to compose professional reports, correspondence, job descriptions, policies and procedures, and other documents.
Extensive knowledge of Equal Opportunity and Diversity initiatives as they relate to the Unviersity of California.
